svg.text: Actuator neural network (branch dof8): state of 50 numbers to 8 joint commands
Champion: SOM + RBF encoding, 75 hidden units, 600 policy weights. Lower panel: embedding variant (branch embed_actuator), 15 inputs, 120 weights.
Fixed during agent learning: normalisation constants, the three SOMs (trained on 200 000 babbling frames), sigma_b and the gains. Learned: W (the policy map prototypes).
f1 prox, f1 dist, f2 prox, f2 dist
Sizes: A has 3 SOM blocks of 25 units (75 hidden, 600 weights); B has a 15-number code (120 weights). The state, signs, bases, clipping and the environment are the same.
Files: src/SMAgent.py, src/GripAgent.py, src/Actuator.py, src/grip_map_v2.py, src/GripMapping.py, src/embedding_map.py, tools/box2dsim/box2dsim/envs/Box2DSim_env.py
